body.content: Counterexample candidate: A large service has N internal replicas on diverse hardware. A decentralized network has N small services, each using the same cloud provider's managed database. The cloud provider's managed database fails. The large service survives (it used diverse hardware). The decentralized network fails completely. The 'causal independence barrier' was an illusion of organizational separation, not a true topological barrier.
body.possible_next_move: Formalize the conditions under which organizational separation does not imply causal independence.
body.why_keep_this: Illustrates the core risk of assuming decentralization implies independence.
